results.title: Laos to Raise Private Sector Minimum Wage to LAK 3.4 Million from January 2027
results.content: Laos will raise the minimum monthly pay for private sector workers to LAK 3.4 million (USD 150) from January 2027, the Prime Minister’s Office announced in a notice dated 21 October. The new total combines a higher base wage of LAK 2 million (USD 88) with a larger living allowance of LAK 1.4 million (USD […]
